claims.text: Guests can kayak, paddleboard or set out by boat from the marina.

findings.quote: Waterfront Adventures: Kayak, paddleboard, or set out by boat from our marina.

claims.text: Tarpon Point Marina, next to the resort, offers deep-water slips, transient dockage, a fuel dock and dock-and-dine access to Marina Village shops and restaurants.

findings.quote: Treat your taste buds to fine steaks and fresh seafood with gorgeous waterfront views of the Caloosahatchee River and Tarpon Point Marina.
